parsed.post: New best! 0.9783 achieved with DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.035, and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144. The lower learning rate and increased optimizer steps seem to be yielding consistent improvements. Next: testing if we can push even lower with MATRIX_LR=0.025 to see if we hit the convergence floor.
parsed.description: Testing a further reduction in learning rate to 0.025 to see if the monotone improvement trend continues or if we hit underfitting.
